author: rApq
content: De-hype slice 1 approach: keep narrative flair only in localized intro/conclusion sections (README opening metaphor stays); technicalize body/mechanism prose. Targeted the RFC-1 program docs (mine) + safe README trims: dropped emphatic adverbs (exactly/precisely), editorializing tails (a delta in the program's favor, most material correction, the headline that lands, the asymmetry is safe). Substance/claims/IDs unchanged. Public docs (RATIONALE/thermite-design bodies) + source comments are later slices.
